# Denied name hashes — lowercase SHA-256 of tokens that must never appear in this repo.
#
# NO PLAINTEXT. This file is public; the comment names only the PSEUDONYM side.
# Enforced by scripts/name-hygiene.sh (wired into scripts/verify.sh via CLAUDE.md).
# The substitution table lives OUTSIDE this repo — see rules/public-surface-hygiene.md.
#
# Hashing cannot match substrings, so every casing and compound form is its own line.
# The hashes are unsalted and a short name falls to a dictionary: they exist to stop
# accidental recurrence, not a determined reader. Stated plainly in the rule.
